title: Stream transcript (invalid): DATA_WRITE for an uninitialised Stream ID
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT for Stream ID 0x0042, followed by a DATA_WRITE for Stream ID 0x0099. No session has been established for 0x0099, so the entry must be rejected with SAR_ERR_STREAM_STATE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
Stream ID 0x0099 has no active session; data for it must be rejected.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
